title: Story premise EDU005: The Bag That Refuses a Promise
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (basic math). Hook: Three blues and one orange: can orange still win? Takeaway/theme: A more likely outcome is not a guaranteed outcome.
description: A host wants to predict the next color from a bag with three blue tokens and one orange token, but a surprising orange draw ruins a confident announcement. A probability label replaces the promise.
